head: pr17402-r49
report:
The prior head is available. Diff the two trees directly.

## DEFECT: `setEditorComponent` gives the factory an `EditorTheme` with every style function removed

**Mechanism.** At this head `context-surfaces.ts` (`setEditorComponent` → `optionalScoped(factory, (tui, theme, keybindings) => [handedTUI(tui), copyHostData(theme), …])`) copies the editor theme with `copyHostData`. `copyHostData` builds a `HostCopier` with no `onFunction` handler, so it drops every function (`DROPPED`). But most of `EditorTheme` is functions (`packages/tui/src/components/editor.ts:653-666`):
- `borderColor`
- `accentColor`, `surfaceColor`, `textColor`
- `hintStyle`
- all of `selectList` (`selectedPrefix`, `selectedText`, `description`, …)

`docs/extensions.md:1121` says the factory must return a `CustomEditor` subclass, and that is built from this theme. The editor stores it as `#theme` (`editor.ts:964-965`). Its autocomplete popup builds `new SelectList(items, …, this.#theme.selectList, …)` (`editor.ts:5076`) and renders it inside `render()` (`editor.ts:1831`). `SelectList` calls `this.theme.selectedText(...)`. `hintStyle` quietly falls back to the default dim style. Any extension code that calls `theme.borderColor(...)` or `theme.selectList.*` itself throws. This copy was added in this round to close the prior round's "raw `EditorTheme`" finding; the fix overshoots.

**Trigger.** Use a real `AgentSession`, `InteractiveMode` and `ExtensionUiController`, and get `ui = runner.handedUIContext(hostUI)`. Call `ui.setEditorComponent((_tui, editorTheme) => new CustomEditor(editorTheme))` while the session is live, then use `editorTheme`.

**Measured** with probe `scratch/…/editor-theme.test.ts`, run from `packages/coding-agent`:
```
{"hostBorderColor":"function","handedBorderColor":"undefined","hostSelectedText":"function","handedSelectedText":"undefined","editorIsExtension":true,"render":"ok"}
{"selectList":"TypeError: this.theme.selectedText is not a function. (In 'this.theme.selectedText(`${prefix}${iconCell}${truncatedValue}`)', 'this.theme.selectedText' is undefined)", ...}
```
- The plain editor render succeeds only because `InteractiveMode` overwrites `editor.borderColor` itself (`interactive-mode.ts:4501-4529`).
- I did not get the editor's own popup to show in the probe; my Tab-driven attempt left no list visible. So the crash is shown on a `SelectList` built from the handed `selectList`, which is the same value the editor passes at `editor.ts:5076`.
- The repository test for this change (`extension-ui-factory-surfaces.test.ts:1211`) disposes the session before anything is drawn, so it never sees this.

**Fix shape.** Copy the theme while keeping its style functions. Either hand fresh wrappers, the way `handedTheme` treats `Theme`, or copy only the mutable data parts (`symbols`, the spinner frames array) and keep the function members.

## NOT A DEFECT

What changed between the prior head (`2e9c2ac3`) and this one: provider-gate, model-registry, boundary-data, callback-ownership, compact-handler, context-surfaces, loader, managed-timers, runner, types, extension-ui-controller, session-maintenance, tui renderer-scope, plus docs and tests. `agent-session.ts` did not change between the two rounds.

**Earlier findings and whether they are closed at this head.** Each was judged from the source diff; apart from the editor-theme item, I did not re-run the earlier probes.

| Earlier finding | Status at this head | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Claude 1: 512-level depth limit breaks `getTree()` and `emitContext` | Closed | `HostCopier` copies iteratively; the depth limit is replaced by `HOST_DATA_NODE_LIMIT = 1_000_000` objects. |
| Claude 2: string `ctx.ui` members skip the gate after dispose | Closed | `text()` now always goes through `copiedIn`, i.e. `runOwned`. Facades are now one per session (`handedUIContext(ui, session)`). |
| Claude 3: `onHandle` receives the host's `OverlayHandle` | Closed | `handOverlayHandle` wraps it: hide is always allowed, un-hide only while the session is live. |
| Claude 4: the abort reason is the host's object by identity | Closed on three paths | Copies via `ProviderCallGate.hand` (`provider-gate.ts`), `followWithCopiedReason` (boundary-data) and `copiedReason` (renderer-scope `scopedSignal`). I did not re-check `HandedSignals.admit`. |
| Claude 5: raw `EditorTheme` handed to `setEditorComponent` | Closed as stated | The fix causes the defect above. |
| Claude 6: a timer scheduled after the shutdown sweep runs for the next session | Closed | `ManagedTimers` now owns the callback when it is scheduled (`this.own(callback)`), so it stays tied to the scheduling session. |
| Claude 7: one provider gate per runtime comes back to life for the next session | Closed | Per-session owners (`forSession`/`#ownerFor(lease)`); the gate is cached per owner; `sameRegistrant` handles withdrawals. |
| Astra 1: a late dialog runs its option callbacks after disposal | Closed | `extension-ui-controller.ts` refuses a late component with `!scope.live` before `overlayOptions` or `onHandle` run, and the option callbacks are owned by the session. |
| Astra 2: `ctx.compact` callbacks get host objects | Closed | `#ownCompactionCallback` copies the arguments with `copyHostData`; `compact-handler` rethrows a copied error. |
| Astra 3: a throwing error accessor escapes the copier | Closed | `HostCopier.#error` reads properties with `readQuietly`. |

**New code I looked at and found no defect in:**
- **Per-session registration withdrawal** (`#registeringSession`, `#listFor`, `#setFor`, `ExtensionCallbackLease.whenRetired`/`release`). Load-time registrations stay with the runtime because the factory now runs under `runLoading`. Restore-on-withdraw keeps a later replacement.
- **Queued provider registrations.** They are drained in `sdk.ts`, `main.ts` and `models-cli.ts` straight into `modelRegistry.registerProvider(…, runtime)`, so they are never scoped to a session and never withdrawn.
- **Provider withdrawal scopes.** `pi.unregisterProvider` (`registrant` scope) still removes registrations made in a session: a session view's `registrant` is the runtime, and the runtime gate's registrant is the runtime itself.
- **Reason copies.** `copyHostData` on a reason only affects the signal the extension is handed. Host checks such as `signal.reason === TERMINAL_TOOL_RESULT_ABORT_REASON` read the host's own signal.

**Environment:** the first probe run failed only on module resolution. Adding a `node_modules` symlink inside the scratch directory fixed it.
